verdict.rationale: Netlify's own materials say every PR gets a preview URL through Deploy Previews. Independent community users confirm the GitHub integration renders a preview build of every PR. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how Deploy Previews are configured and which Git providers they support, beyond marketing-level statements.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Every PR gets a preview URL.
